derivation_steps: NCERT's quoted class of mutagens is chemical and physical factors, with radiation (UV) as the named physical example
gamma rays are radiation, hence a physical factor, so they fall inside that quoted class and can induce mutations = option 1, Gamma rays

evidence.exact_line: However, there are many chemical and physical factors that induce mutations.
UV radiations can cause mutations in organisms – it is a mutagen.

missing: gamma rays named as a mutagen — NCERT 4.7 Mutation names only UV radiations
zeatin and kinetin are cytokinins (plant growth regulators), not mutagens
note: Section 4.7 Mutation gives the general class (chemical and physical factors = mutagens) and one worked example, UV radiations. Gamma rays themselves are never named in this chapter, so the quoted lines support the answer only by class membership, not outright. The three distractors cannot be eliminated from this chapter at all: zeatin and kinetin are cytokinins, which belong to Plant Growth and Development (Class XI), and infrared radiation appears nowhere in Principles of Inheritance and Variation.
